Name: Junimo Plushies Expanded
Author: SterlingDraven
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/w4i1ub0.gif[/img]﻿
[b][size=4][color=#ffe599]Junimo[/color] [color=#b6d7a8]Plushies[/color][color=#e69138] [/color][color=#c9daf8]Expanded[/color][/size][/b]

[size=3]Wish there were more Junimo plushies, or that you could rotate them like other furniture? [/size]
[size=3]Well, problem solved! With this mod, you'll have 23 colorful Junimo plushies to display in your home, in both sizes!
[/size]
[img]https://i.imgur.com/PLWyCyo.png[/img][/center]
Note: All plushies are available in Pierre's shop. [s]Otherwise, you can spawn them directly by typing  [font=Courier New][size=2][b]dga_store[/b][/size][/font]  in the SMAPI console[/s].[b]*[/b]
﻿  There is also an Alternative Textures pack under "Optional Files". Note that the plushies in this pack cannot be rotated.
﻿  Both packs can be used together.
﻿ [b]﻿*[/b] Since DGA has been phased out sine the 1.6 update, the main file will use [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url] from now on. The Alternative Textures version should be unaffected.
 
[left]
[size=3][color=#ffd966]Installation:[/color]
[/size][size=2]- Be sure to have the latest version of [/size][url=https://smapi.io/]SMAPI[/url][size=2]﻿ and [/size][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/23458]Furniture Framework[/url] [size=2]installed[/size]
﻿~ [size=2]Also[/size] [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/9246]Alternative Textures[/url]﻿[size=2] for the pack under "Optional Files"[/size]
[size=2]- Download this mod and unzip it to your mods folder (Stardew Valley/Mods)[/size]
[size=2] ﻿~ Avoid using using mod managers, such as Vortex, for Stardew Valley mods. It tends to only complicate things.[/size]
[size=2]- Run the game and enjoy![/size]

[size=3][color=#ffd966]Changelog:[/color][/size]
[size=3][b]3.0.1:[/b] Update to FF v.3 (again, sorry for the delay!)[/size]

[size=2][b]3.0: [/b]Update for 1.6 (sorry it took so long). Converts everything to Furniture Framework. The Alternative Textures version should still work as is. As always, be sure to delete the previous version before updating to avoid errors.

[b]2.1: [/b]Added a few more colors

[b]2.0:[/b] 1. Converts everything over to DGA - Be sure to delete the previous version before updating and running your ﻿game to avoid errors.
2. Added one more color
[/size]
[color=#ffd966][size=3]Bugs and Error Reporting:[/size][/color]
[size=2]If for any reason you have issues with this mod, please report them to the Bugs tab.

[b][size=4][color=#c9daf8][/color][/size][/b]
[/size][color=#c9daf8][size=4][b]Special th[b][/b][b][size=4][color=#c9daf8]an[/color][/size][/b]ks:[/b][/size][/color][/left][size=3][url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/users/3490737]CyanFire[/url] for their [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/12688](DGA) More Junimo Plushies[/url] conversion, without which I never would have figured out DGA's json format.
Thank you!![/size]
